title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 1+1 NE BLLOK PRANE LIBRIT UNIVERSITAR
description_sq:
Ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara ne rrugen kryesore Abdyl Frasheri prane Librit Universitar dhe prane zones se ish-Bllokut shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe totale 50m2 total.
Apartamenti eshte i arreduar ne menyre bashkekohore.
Ndodhet ne katin e 4-et dhe te fundit te nje pallati ekzistues buze rruges Abdyl Frasheri .
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE BLOCK NEAR THE UNIVERSITY LIBRARY
description_en: In one of the most sought-after areas on the main Abdyl Frasheri street, near the University Library and near the area of ​​the former Block, a 1+1 apartment with a total area of ​​50m2 is for sale. The apartment is furnished in a contemporary way. It is located on the 4th and last floor of an existing building on the edge of Abdyl Frasheri Street. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
